newsitem.title: USA: NeXstar says Liposome files suit in UK.
newsitem.headline: NeXstar says Liposome files suit in UK.

text.p: NeXstar Pharmaceuticals Inc said on Friday that Liposome Co has filed a patent infringement lawsuit against NeXstar in the United Kingdom over the technology of freeze drying liposomes.
A Liposome Co spokesman said the company is asserting its claim over a technology that it has developed.

A liposome is a microscopic fat bubble that can be used to encase drugs to target diseased cells without hurting healthy tissues. A NeXstar spokeswoman said this process leads to fewer side effects while striking the diseased cell with stronger compounds.
NeXstar said the two companies have filed lawsuits against one another. A trial in the United States is set for October 1997, NeXstar said.

"This action was not unexpected," said NeXstar chief executive officer Patrick Mahaffy said in a statement. "It simply completes the picture, putting both the validity and alleged infringement of these patents in issue on both sides of the Atlantic."

The Liposome Co had previously sued NeXstar Pharmaceuticals' predecessor for alleged infringement of another U.S. patent relating to freeze-drying of liposomes, and judgment was entered against Liposome in that case by a Delaware federal district court, the company said.
NeXstar, which is based in Boulder, Colorado, makes compounds to treat cancer and infectious diseases.
